newsitem.title: USA: Apple declines comment on Be speculation.
newsitem.headline: Apple declines comment on Be speculation.

text.p: A spokeswoman for Apple Computer Inc declined comment on persistent news reports citing rumours the ailing computer maker may be weighing an acquisition of Menlo Park-based startup Be Inc.
Be, founded by former Apple executive Jean-Louis Gassee, has developed a new operating system aimed at going a step beyond existing personal computer systems software.
Earlier this year it demonstrated how the software system operates on Apple's PowerPC platform.
"Be is an Apple developer. We work with Be as we would any Apple developer. We have provided limited technical support to Be in the porting of BeOS to PowerPC platform," the Apple spokeswoman said.
She declined any further comment on a story in Tuesday's USA Today newspaper reporting that Apple and Be are considering entering serious talks on Apple Computer buying Be.
